name: Greyford
description: A market town where three roads meet at a stone bridge. Barges wait below for the river to rise.

name: Ashmere
description: Reed roofs and smoking chimneys on the edge of the fen. Eel traps dry on every fence.

name: Hollin Keep
description: A square tower on a holly-covered rise, watching both roads. Its gate closes at dusk.

name: Vellmarket
description: A walled town of wool merchants. Bales stand in the square under oiled cloth.
